plain_english: By the boon-giving hand, You enact universe-glory-giving. Not indeed supreme-principle-fixed by glory-stains touched ever.
sanskrit_cite: varadena pāṇinā tvaṃ viśvavibhūtipradatvam abhinayasi na khalu paratattvaniṣṭho vibhavamalaiḥ spṛśyate jātu

plain_english: By fearlessness, world-fears uprooting shown always. World-grace-cause-nature Yours by palm.
sanskrit_cite: abhayena ca bhavabhayāni unmūlayatā prakāśyate satatam viśvānugrahakāraṇasvabhāvatā tava karatalena

plain_english: Unfamed-formed, unequal, Māyā's shattered head — there this, by supreme waking, borne by me as skull — thus You show.
sanskrit_cite: akhyātirūpam asamaṃ māyāyāḥ śakalitaṃ śiro 'traitat parabodhamayena mayā muṇḍaṃ bibhrat prakāśayasy evam

plain_english: Wholly-essence-taken, in me, alone world-rest — in consciousness-one-mass thus. By skull-staff-bone-bearing pretext, You give command.
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣahṛtasārā mayy eva jagatsthitiś cidekaghane iti khaṭvāṅgakaraṅkodvahanacchalato dadāsy ājñām

plain_english: Lute-bell-drum, O Uddāmara, playing — this You show. Triple-split function sound hearing, standing am I — thus.
sanskrit_cite: vīṇāghaṇtāḍamarūn uḍḍāmara vādayann idaṃ diśasi vṛttitribhedabhinnaṃ nādaṃ śṛṇvan sthito 'smīti

plain_english: Moreover — Parā-etc.-power-triple-spoke-lovely great power — gods You imitate outside, by trident-holding pretext, always — You.
sanskrit_cite: kiṃ ca parādikaśaktitritayārāsundarām mahāśaktim devānukaroṣi bahis triśūladhāraṇamiṣeṇa nityaṃ tvam

plain_english: Will-etc.-own-power-shown-lower-abode-threefold — own indeed supreme power, thunderbolt-made — borne, six-spoked — You.
sanskrit_cite: icchādikanijaśaktiprakāśitādhaḥsthagocaratritayām svām eva parāṃ śaktiṃ vajramayīṃ vahasi ṣaḍarāṃ tvam

plain_english: World all by my power subdued, all stations holds — thus by staff-holding revealed Consciousness-Bhairava to us.
sanskrit_cite: jagad akhilaṃ macchaktyā damitaṃ sarvavyāvasthitīr dhatte iti daṇḍadhāraṇavaśād vyanakṣi cidbhairavāsmākam

plain_english: Mace-axe bearing, dot-sound-imitating-formed — distinction-undistinction-splitting-bent, O Īśāna — You indicate.
sanskrit_cite: mudgaraparaśū bibhrad baindavanādānukārarūpau tvam bhedavibhedanaśakalanaparatvam īśāna nirdiśasi

plain_english: By vision-difference, O Lord — various form assuming — Bhairava-supreme-waking-made proclaimed — own abode everywhere.
sanskrit_cite: darśanabhedāt svāminn anyānyām āhṛtiṃ dadhānas tvam bhairavaparabodhamayaṃ prathayasi nijadhāma sarvatra
